bank.a: Awa. I-Tengo yi-app yokulinga elinganisela bona imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingangani. Ayibulungi imali, ayibolekisi, ayithengisi imikhiqizo begodu ayinikeli iinyeluleko zeemali.

data.a: Njengesivakatjhi, ilwazi lakho lihlala ebhrawuzarini le esisetjenzisweni sakho begodu akukho okuthunyelwa ku-Tengo. Nanyana ngubani osebenzisa ibhrawuza le angalivula, ngalokho sebenzisa ukukhiya nge-PIN efowunini eyabelanwako. I-akhawunti ngeyokuzikhethela; ibulunga ilwazi lakho kumhlinzeki wesizindalwazi obalwe esazisweni sefihlo.

cost.a: Litho. I-Tengo imahala ngesikhathi sokulinga, akutlhogeki ukutlolisa.

wrong.a: Sisilinganiso esivela emlandweni wakho, ngalokho singaba simbi. Vula Kubayini ilanga leli bona ubone okufakiweko, lungisa nanyana ngiliphi ithengiselwano ku-Imali, nanyana usebenzise Buza ngomphumela lo bona ubawe ukuhlolwa. Kule demo isibawo leso siyalingiswa begodu sihlala esisetjenzisweni sakho.

why.plain: Sithoma ngebhalansi yakho yanamhlanje, sisuse amabhadelo ngamalanga wawo, bese sisebenzisa ngezinga lakho elijayelekileko lelanga bekube imali ifika ku-ziro. Ilanga lelo lilanga lakho. Imali ongakayifumani ayibalwa.

me.title: Mina
me.nameBody: I-Tengo isuka ebizweni elithi mutengo, ibizo lesiVenda elitjho ukuqakatheka. Umhlathiso lo unikelwe mthomi begodu usazokuqinisekiswa sikhulumi sesiVenda.

how.1: Ihlukanisa umlando wakho ube yimali engenako, amabhadelo ajayelekileko nokusebenzisa kwamalanga woke.
how.2: Ibala ukusebenzisa kwakho okujayelekileko kwelanga ukusuka emalangeni ama-60 wokugcina, kunye neveke elula neveke ebudisi.
how.3: Ifumana bona imali yakho elandelako ijayele ukungena nini nokobana ijayele ukuba malini.
how.4: Yehlisa ibhalansi yakho ilanga ngelanga, isuse amabhadelo ngamalanga wawo, bekube ifika ku-ziro. Ilanga lelo lilanga lakho.
how.5: Imadanisa ilanga lelo nemali yakho elandelako bona ibeke isimo sakho: Yanele, Yanele kancani nanyana Iyatlhayela.

plan.roomToLendUnsure: I-Tengo ayiqinisekanga ngokwaneleko ngemali yakho engenako bona iphakamise inani. Hlola umphumela wenani elithileko ngaphasi.
plan.notAdvice: Iinlinganiso ezivela emlandweni wakho, akusi seluleko. Akukho lapha okusiqunto sokuboleka nanyana isipho sesikwelede.

money.title: Imali
money.lead: Woke amathengiselwano i-Tengo ewasebenzisako, namabhadelo eyiwafumeneko.
money.emptyBodyNone: Awekho amathengiselwano nje. Ngenisa isitatimende bona uthome.
money.billsRule: Umhlathiso ofanako nenani elifanako, cishe inyanga phakathi.
money.importBody: Layisha isitatimende sebhanga se-CSV. Sifundwa esisetjenzisweni lesi begodu sithatha indawo yomlando womuntu lo.
money.movableHint: Maka ibhadelo kwaphela nangabe lingabhadelwa selibhalele amalanga ambalwa ngaphandle kwenhlawulo.
money.protectedBill: Angekhe kuphakanyiswe bona lihanjiswe: ukubhadela kade kungabiza iinhlawulo, ukuvikelwa nanyana isikwelede.

import.title: Ngenisa isitatimende
import.lead: Sebenzisa isitatimende sebhanga se-CSV bona uthathe indawo yomlando womuntu lo. Angekhe siphume ebhrawuzarini yakho.
import.local: Kusetjenzwa esisetjenzisweni sakho. Akukho okuphuma ebhrawuzarini yakho.
import.formatBody: Ilanga, umhlathiso nenani (elingaphasi kweziro emalini ephumako), nanyana amakholomu ahlukeneko we-debit ne-credit. Amalanga ali-14 nanyana ngaphezulu.
import.empty: Khetha ifayili nanyana usebenzise isitatimende esiyisibonelo bona ubone ukubuka kokuthoma lapha.
import.mappingHint: Siqagele lokhu eenhlokweni. Tjhugulula nanyana yiphi ebonakala ingakalungi.
import.needMapping: Khetha ilanga, umhlathiso, kunye nenani nanyana amakholomu we-debit ne-credit.
import.skipped_one: Kweqiwe umugqa o-{{count}} ngombana ilanga, umhlathiso nanyana inani akukghonanga ukufundwa.
import.skipped_other: Kweqiwe imigqa eli-{{count}} ngombana ilanga, umhlathiso nanyana inani akukghonanga ukufundwa.
import.tooShort: Isitatimende lesi sihlanganisa amalanga ali-{{count}}. I-Tengo itlhoga ali-14 nanyana ngaphezulu.
import.noRows: Ayikho imigqa esebenzisekako efunyenweko ngamakholomu la.
import.wideRange: Amalanga ali-{{count}} kwaphela womlando. Isibikezelo sizokusebenza, kodwana ibanga lizokuba libanzi.
import.shifted_one: Amalanga ahanjiswe phambili ngelanga eli-{{count}} bona isitatimende siphele izolo.
import.shifted_other: Amalanga ahanjiswe phambili ngamalanga ali-{{count}} bona isitatimende siphele izolo.
import.balanceFromFile: Ithethwe ebhalansini yokugcina efayilini: {{amount}}. Tlola bona uyitjhugulule.
import.balanceKept: Ayikho ikholomu yebhalansi. Kubulungwa ibhalansi yanje ka-{{amount}}. Tlola bona uyitjhugulule.
import.confirm: Faka umlando omutjha bese ubona ilanga lami
import.replaceNote: Lokhu kuthatha indawo yomlando womuntu lo esisetjenzisweni lesi begodu kufaka okufakiweko erekhodini lokuhlola.
import.tooBig: Ifayili lelo likhulu kune-2 MB, okungaphezu kwalokho isitatimende esikutlhogako. Khetha isikhathi esifitjhani nanyana ifayili elincani.

edit.title: Hlela ithengiselwano
edit.auditNote: Ukubulunga kufaka okufakiweko erekhodini lakho lokuhlola.
edit.oneOffHint: Kutjhiywe ngaphandle kwephethini yakho ejayelekileko yokusebenzisa nemali engenako. Kusabalwa ebhalansini yakho.

audit.plan_settings: Kutjhugululwe ukusebenzisa okungancitjhiswa nanyana amabhadelo angahanjiswa
audit.money_updated: Kutjhugululwe ii-akhawunti nanyana imali okwelwedwa yona

inbox.title: Imilayezo
inbox.offBody: Uvale imilayezo yamalanga woke, ngalokho akukho okungabukwa kokuthoma. Yivule lapha nanyana ku-Ifihlo.
inbox.languageHint: Imilayezo ingasebenzisa ilimi elihlukileko kwelinye le-app.

facts.what: Ilanga lakho, isimo nesabelomali selanga kwaphela.
facts.never: Angekhe kube yibhalansi yakho nanyana amathengiselwano wakho.
facts.stop: Umlayezo ngamunye utjho bona uvela ku-Tengo nokobana ungayimisa njani. Ungavala imilayezo godu ku-Ifihlo.
facts.where: Imilayezo ye-WhatsApp ibizokudlula ku-Meta, ngaphandle kweSewula Afrika. I-SMS yenye indlela. Kulingiswa lapha: akukho okuthunyelwako.

whatsapp.tight: Imali yakho kufuze ihlale bekube ngu-*{{date}}* ngeveke ejayelekileko. Isimo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_one: Imali yakho ingaphela ngo-*{{date}}*, ilanga eli-{{count}} ngaphambi kwemali yakho elandelako. Isimo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_other: Imali yakho ingaphela ngo-*{{date}}*, amalanga ali-{{count}} ngaphambi kwemali yakho elandelako. Isimo: {{state}}.

tip.tight: Gcina ukusebenzisa kwakho eduze nesabelomali sakho selanga bekube kufike imali yakho elandelako.
tip.short: Qala u-Hlela ku-Tengo bona ubone okusiza khulu.

whatsapp.discreet: Tengo: ilwazi lakho lelanga lilungile. Vula i-app bona ulibone.
whatsapp.noNextDaily: Imali ingena amalanga amanengi, ngalokho alikho ibhadelo linye elilandelako.

help.title: Okusiza khulu
help.moveBill: Nangabe i-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ingabhadelwa ngemva kwaka-{{date}} ngaphandle kwenhlawulo, lokho kwaphela kufikelela ku-{{state}}.
help.setAside: Ungabeka eqadi bekube ngu-{{amount}} namhlanje begodu usahlala ku-Yanele bekube kufike imali yakho elandelako. Lesi sikhala esifanako nesithi Isikhala sokuboleka, ingasi esengeziweko.
help.coveredBody: Imali yakho kufuze ihlale bekube kufike imali yakho elandelako, ngitjho neveke ebudisi khulu.
help.earn: Fumana nanyana wamukele u-{{amount}} owengeziweko ngaphambi kwaka-{{date}}, isibonelo umsebenzi owengeziweko nanyana imali okwelwedwa yona.
help.earnAssume: Kucatjangwa bona ukusebenzisa kwakho kuhlala njengokujayelekileko. Ukuboleka bona uvale isikhala kujayele ukubiza khulu ngemva.
help.trim: Sebenzisa cishe u-{{amount}} ngelanga ngaphasi ku-{{groups}} bekube ngu-{{date}}.
help.trimAssume: Ukusebenzisa kwaphela okumakileko njengokungancitjhiswa. Kucatjangwa bona koke okhunye kuhlala njengokujayelekileko.
help.trimPartial: Lokho kusebenzisa koke okumakileko njengokungancitjhiswa, ngalokho kuvala ingcenye yesikhala. Okuseleko kusatlhoga imali engenako.
help.moveAssume: Ulimake njengelingahanjiswa. Buza kokuthoma. Ungeqi ama-debit order weenkwelede nanyana womshuwaransi.
help.markFlexible: Maka ukusebenzisa kwamalanga woke okungancitjhiswa bona ubone lapho ungaquma khona.
help.freeHelp: Nangabe usele emuva eenkweledeni, i-National Credit Regulator ibala isizo samahala:
help.ideasNote: Imibono, akusi seluleko. Hlola iimali neenhlawulo ngaphambi kokutjhugulula ibhadelo.

spending.title: Lapho imali yamalanga woke iya khona
spending.empty: Akukho ukusebenzisa kwamalanga woke emalangeni ama-30 wokugcina.
spending.flexibleHint: Maka ukusebenzisa ongakunciphisa nangabe imali iyatlhayela. Iindleko zomsebenzi ezifana nesitokhwe nepetroli angekhe ziphakanyiselwe ukuncitjhiswa.

palette.title: Imenyu yeenqophiso
palette.placeholder: Iya ekhasini, tjhugulula umuntu, tjhugulula ilimi
palette.help: Iinkinobho zemitjhoba bona uhambe, Enter bona ukhethe, Esc bona uvale.

overdrawn.title: Ukweleda ngo-{{amount}} ebhanga
overdrawn.body: Imali engenako ibhadela lokhu kokuthoma. Ilanga lakho libalwa ukusukela lapho ibhalansi isingaphezu kwaka-R0 godu.

asOf.title: Ukusuka esitatimendeni sakho
asOf.body_one: Isibikezelo lesi sivela esitatimendeni sakho, esiphela ngo-{{date}}, ilanga eli-{{count}} elidlulileko. Faka ibhalansi yanamhlanje bona usibuyekeze.
asOf.body_other: Isibikezelo lesi sivela esitatimendeni sakho, esiphela ngo-{{date}}, amalanga ali-{{count}} adlulileko. Faka ibhalansi yanamhlanje bona usibuyekeze.

historyEnds.title: Umlando uphela ngo-{{date}}
historyEnds.body: Ukusebenzisa ukusukela ngesikhathi leso akukho emlandweni wakho, ngalokho isibikezelo sisebenzisa iphethini bekube lilanga lelo nebhalansi yanamhlanje.

paused.title: Imali engenako ibonakala imisiwe
paused.body: Akukho okufana namabhadelo wakho ajayelekileko okungenileko ukusukela ngo-{{date}}. I-Tengo ayisathembi imali elandelako begodu esikhundleni salokho ihlola amalanga ama-30 ezako.

notice.pausedNoDate: Akukho okufana namabhadelo wakho ajayelekileko okungenileko isikhathi esithileko. I-Tengo ayisathembi imali elandelako begodu esikhundleni salokho ihlola amalanga ama-30 ezako.

irregular.title: Ayikabi khona iphethini ejayelekileko
irregular.body: Imali iyangena, kodwana ingasi ngesigqi i-Tengo engasisebenzisa. Ihlola amalanga ama-30 ezako esikhundleni selanga lemali elandelako.

pendingToday.title: Ibhadelo lifanele namhlanje
pendingToday.body: Ibhadelo lakho elijayelekileko lifanele namhlanje begodu alikangeni ebhalansini yakho, ngalokho lisabalwa njengelizako.

missedBill.title: I-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ibonakala ingakabhadelwa
missedBill.body: Bekufanele cishe ngo-{{date}} begodu akhenge ibonakale. Tjela i-Tengo bona kwenzekeni bona ilanga lihlale lilungile.

oneOffs.body_one: Imali ekulu eyenzeka kanye eli-{{count}} itjhiywe ngaphandle kokusebenzisa nemali engenako ejayelekileko.
oneOffs.body_other: Iimali ezikulu ezenzeka kanye ezili-{{count}} zitjhiywe ngaphandle kokusebenzisa nemali engenako ejayelekileko.

notice.label: Izinto okufuze uzihlole

askOneOff.title: Kghani i-{{name}} ({{amount}}, {{date}}) beyiyinto eyenzeka kanye?
askOneOff.body: Ikulu khulu kunokusebenzisa kwakho okujayelekileko, begodu ngomlando omfitjhani i-Tengo ayikghoni ukutjho. Nje ibalwa njengokusebenzisa okujayelekileko.

estimated.title: Kulinganiselwe eempendulweni zakho
estimated.body: Ingcenye yomlando wakho ivela emibuzweni yokulungiselela, ngalokho ukuqiniseka kuphasi. Okufakiweko kwamambala, ikheshi oyifaka lapha nanyana isitatimende kuthatha indawo yesilinganiso.

sample.title: Iinomboro eziyisibonelo
sample.body: Isibikezelo lesi sisebenzisa iinomboro eziyisibonelo, ingasi zakho. Zitjhugulule ku-Imali, nanyana uzithathele indawo ngesitatimende nanyana ngeempendulo zakho.

quota.title: Akukghonakalanga ukubulunga esisetjenzisweni lesi
quota.body: Ibulungelo lebhrawuza le lizele, ngalokho itjhugululo lakho lokugcina alikabulungwa. Khupha ilwazi lakho, bese ukhulula isikhala nanyana usule ilwazi elidala.

unavailable.title: Akukghonakalanga ukubulunga esisetjenzisweni lesi
unavailable.body: Ibhrawuza le ivimba ibulungelo, isibonelo efesidereni elifihlakeleko, ngalokho itjhugululo lakho lokugcina alikabulungwa.

corrupt.title: Ilwazi lakho elibulungiweko alikghonanga ukufundwa
corrupt.body: Kukhona okungakahambi kuhle ngelwazi elibulungwe ebhrawuzarini le. Ikopi ibulungwe esisetjenzisweni lesi. Thoma kabutjha bona uragele phambili usebenzisa i-Tengo.

hints.in: Ikheshi olifumeneko, isibonelo imali yokukhwela, umthengi nanyana imali ebuyiswe mndeni. Libalwa njengemali engenako.
hints.hand: Ikheshi onalo nje. Lokhu kubeka ibhalansi yekheshi begodu akufaki okufakiweko.

accounts.title: Lapho imali yakho ikhona
accounts.lead: Isibikezelo sakho sisebenzisa isamba sakho koke lokhu.
accounts.name: Ibizo
accounts.homeLine: Isamba {{total}}, kufaka phakathi u-{{cash}} wekheshi elisesandleni.

obligations.title: Enye imali oyikweledako
obligations.lead: Istokvel, umasingcwabisane, ukusekela umndeni neenkwelede ezingasi zomthetho. Kubalwa njengamabhadelo.
obligations.name: Ibizo
obligations.movableHint: Kwaphela nangabe ingabhadelwa isilibele amalanga ambalwa ngaphandle kwemiraro.
obligations.protected: Angekhe kuphakanyiswe bona kuhanjiswe: ukubhadela isikwelede nanyana umasingcwabisane kade kungakubiza.

setup.title: Lungiselela ngesandla
setup.lead: Awunasitatimende? Phendula imibuzo embalwa bese i-Tengo ilinganisela umlando wokuthoma. Okufakiweko kwamambala kuthatha indawo yawo njengombana ukufaka.
setup.pretend: Ungasebenzisa iinomboro zokuzenzisa bona ukulinge. Akukho okuphuma esisetjenzisweni lesi.
setup.arrives: Indlela imali yakho ejayele ukungena ngayo

arrivalHint.daily: Isibonelo imali yokukhwela ngekheshi nanyana ukuthengisa amalanga amanengi.
arrivalHint.weekly: Isibonelo ibhadelo leveke nanyana imali yaMgqibelo.
arrivalHint.irregular: Isibonelo imali efakwako cishe qobe veke, kodwana ingasi ngelanga elibekiweko.

setup.dailySpendHint: Ukudla, ukuthutha, i-airtime nokhunye okunjalo. Ingasi irente nanyana amanye amabhadelo.
setup.billsHint: Irente, isivumelwano sefowuni, imali yesikolo namanye amabhadelo abhadelwa qobe nyanga.
setup.billError: Ibhadelo ngalinye litlhoga ibizo, inani elingaphezu kweziro nelanga elisuka ku-1 ukuya ku-31.
setup.estimatedNote: I-Tengo yenza umlando wokuthoma ukusuka eempendulweni lezi, umakwe njengolinganiselweko. Ukuqiniseka kuhlala kuphasi bekube kufika okufakiweko kwamambala.

safetyPolicy.title: Ukuphepha nokobana i-Tengo ngekabani
safetyPolicy.lead: Indlela i-Tengo evikela ngayo abantu abasebenzisa iinfowuni ezabelanwako, abantu abasengozini nabantwana.
safetyPolicy.draft: Umthethomgomo oyihlelo wokulinga, ozokubuyekezwa mmeli nomeluleki wokuvikela.

adults.title: Abantu abadala kwaphela
adults.body: I-Tengo ngeyabantu abadala. Nangabe uneminyaka engaphasi kwe-18, siyabawa ungayisebenzisi. Ukubulunga ku-akhawunti kukubawa bona uqinisekise bona uneminyaka eli-18 nanyana ngaphezulu. I-Tengo ayibawi ilanga lokubelethwa nanyana inomboro kamazisi, begodu abantu bokwakhiwa bedemo babantu abadala.

shared.title: Iinfowuni ezabelanwako
shared.body: Ungabeka i-PIN bona i-Tengo izikhiye ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa, uvule indlela yokufihla bona iimali zihlale zifihliwe bekube uzithinta bona uzibone, begodu usebenzise ukuphuma msinyana bona utjhiye i-Tengo uye ekhasini elingenalitho ngesikhathi leso. Imilayezo efihliweko ayinazo iimali, amalanga nanyana amabizo wesimo.

control.title: Nangabe umuntu uphethe imali yakho
control.body: Akakho umuntu okufuze akukatelele bona utjengise isibikezelo sakho, wabelane nge-PIN yakho nanyana unikele ngemali yakho. I-Tengo angekhe ibawe ibizo elifihlakeleko lebhanga nanyana i-PIN. Nangabe umuntu uhlola ifowuni yakho, ukuphuma msinyana nokukhiya nge-PIN kuyasiza, begodu ungasula ilwazi lakho nanyana kunini ku-Ifihlo.

care.title: Ukunakekela abantu abasesimeni esibudisi
care.body: I-Tengo isebenzisa amabizo alula, itjengisa iinlinganiso ingasi iinyeluleko, begodu angekhe iphakamise ukuboleka, ukweqa ibhadelo lesikwelede nanyana lomshuwaransi, nanyana ukunciphisa isitokhwe sebhizinisi. Nangabe imali ibonakala itlhayela, ikhomba isizo samahala esivela ku-National Credit Regulator.

never.title: Lokho i-Tengo engekhe ikwenze
never.body: I-Tengo ayenzi iinqunto zokuboleka nanyana zesikwelede, ayithengisi imikhiqizo, begodu ayabelani ngelwazi lakho nanyana ngubani ngokukhangisa. Akukho okumalungana nesibikezelo sakho okusetjenziselwa ukukwahlulela.

help.title: Nangabe utlhoga isizo nje
help.gbv: I-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, mahala begodu ivulekile emini nebusuku.
help.childline: I-Childline, yabantwana nanyana ngubani ozwisa ubuhlungu ngomntwana: 116, mahala.
help.note: Iinomboro zizokuqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuthonywa. I-Tengo akusi sizo sobuphuthumako.

lock.title: I-Tengo ikhiyiwe
lock.lead: Faka i-PIN yakho bona uvule i-Tengo.
lock.wait: Amalingo manengi khulu. Linda kancani bese ulinga godu.
lock.waitFor_one: Amalingo manengi khulu. Linga godu ngemva kwesekhondi eli-{{count}}.
lock.waitFor_other: Amalingo manengi khulu. Linga godu ngemva kwamasekhondi ali-{{count}}.
lock.forgotBody: I-Tengo ayikghoni ukubuyisa i-PIN, ngombana angekhe ibulungwe. Bona uthome kabutjha, sula woke ilwazi le-Tengo esisetjenzisweni lesi. Lokhu angekhe kubuyiselwe emuva.

shared.title: Ukuphepha kwefowuni eyabelanwako
shared.lockOff: Kuvaliwe. Beka i-PIN yeenomboro ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6 bona ukhiye i-Tengo nangabe ungekho.
shared.lockOn: Kuvuliwe. I-Tengo iyazikhiya ngemva kwemizuzu eli-{{count}} ingasetjenziswa.
shared.pinHint: Iinomboro ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6. Ibulungwa kwaphela njengekhowudi ehlanganisiweko esisetjenzisweni lesi begodu angekhe ibuyiswe.
shared.discreetHint: Fihla iimali esikrinini bekube uthinta Tjengisa iimali, begodu uthumele imilayezo engenazo iimali nanyana amalanga.
shared.quickExitHint: Ukuphuma msinyana kuhlala phezulu esikrinini. Kufihla koke begodu kuvula ikhasi elingenalitho.

diag.title: Ukuhlola iimphoso
diag.lead: Kwesizo ngomraro. Alikho ilwazi lomuntu elibulungwa lapha, begodu akukho okuthunyelwako.

own.cardPromise: Iinomboro zakho, ilanga lakho. Akukho okuphuma esisetjenzisweni sakho ngaphandle kobana ubulunga i-akhawunti.
own.cardBody: Ngenisa isitatimende, phendula imibuzo embalwa, nanyana ulinge kokuthoma ngeenomboro eziyisibonelo. Akutlhogeki ukutlolisa.

welcome.title: Sebenzisa imali yakho
welcome.nicknameHint: Lisetjenziselwa ukukulotjhisa kwaphela. Litjhiye lingenalitho nangabe uthanda.

s1.title: Lokho i-Tengo ekubawako, nokobana kubayini
s1.lead: I-Tengo ibala bona imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingangani nokobana imali yakho elandelako ijayele ukungena nini. Itlhoga okuncani kwaphela bona ikwenze lokho.

money.title: Imali yakho engenako nephumako
money.body: Amalanga, iimali nemihlathiso efitjhani, kunye nebhalansi yakho. Ukusuka esitatimendeni, eempendulweni ezimbalwa, nanyana eenomborweni eziyisibonelo.

bills.title: Amabhadelo ajayelekileko nemali oyikweledako
bills.body: Izinto ezifana nerente, isivumelwano sefowuni nanyana i-stokvel, bona i-Tengo ikghone ukuzibulungela imali.

never.title: Angekhe
never.body: I-Tengo angekhe ibawe inomboro kamazisi, inomboro yefowuni, ukungena ebhanga nanyana i-PIN.

where.title: Lapho kuhlala khona
where.body: Esisetjenzisweni lesi kwaphela, ngaphandle kobana ngemva ukhethe ukukubulunga ku-akhawunti. Ungakusula nanyana kunini.

s2.title: Ukukhetha kwakho
s2.lead: Isibikezelo kwaphela esitlhogekako. Koke okhunye kuvaliwe bekube uyakuvula.
s2.core: Kuyatlhogeka bona kubalwe ilanga lakho. Kusebenza esisetjenzisweni lesi. Khupha imvumo nanyana kunini bese kuyema.
s2.notice: Isaziso esipheleleko sefihlo sitjho okubulungwako, kuphi, isikhathi esingangani, nokobana ungakhalaza njani.

s3.title: Faka imali yakho
s3.lead: Khetha indlela yinye. Ungayitjhugulula nanyana uyithathele indawo ngemva ku-Imali.
s3.importBody: Ifayili le-CSV elivela ebhangeni lakho. Lifundwa esisetjenzisweni lesi.
s3.manualBody: Nangabe ungenasitatimende. I-Tengo ilinganisela umlando wokuthoma ukusuka eempendulweni zakho.
s3.sampleBody: Hlola ngaphandle kokutlola litho. Isibonelo simakiwe begodu ungatjhugulula yoke inomboro.

s4.lead: Lesi sisilinganiso esivela eenomborweni ozinikeleko, akusi seluleko. Siba ngcono njengombana ufaka okufakiweko kwamambala.
s4.sample: Lezi ziinomboro eziyisibonelo, ingasi zakho. Zitjhugulule ku-Imali, nanyana uzithathele indawo ngesitatimende nanyana ngeempendulo zakho.

legalDoc.draft: Ihlelo lokulinga, elizokubuyekezwa mmeli ngaphambi kokuthonywa. I-Tengo akusi libhanga begodu ayinikeli iinyeluleko zeemali. Isaziso lesi asitjho bona silandela nanyana ngimuphi umthetho nanyana isitifikeyidi.
legalDoc.placeholderWarning: Ihlangano ephetheko neSiphathimandla seLwazi abakabizwa. Kufuze bagcwaliswe ngaphambi kokuthonywa kwamambala.

what.title: Lokho i-Tengo ekubulungako
what.body: Umlando wemali owufakako (amalanga, iimali, imihlathiso efitjhani neengaba), iibhalansi zakho, amabhadelo ajayelekileko nemali oyikweledako, ukukhetha kwakho namalungiselelo, isiteketiso ongasikhetha, kunye nerekhodi lalokho okwenzileko ku-app. Nangabe ubulunga i-akhawunti, nekheli lakho le-imeyili. I-Tengo ayibawi begodu ayibulungi iinomboro zikamazisi, iinomboro zefowuni, ukungena ebhanga nanyana ama-PIN. Iinomboro ezide emihlathisweni engenisiweko ziyafihlwa.

why.title: Kubayini
why.body: Kwaphela ukubala bona imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingangani, imali yakho elandelako ijayele ukungena nini, neenlinganiso ezisesikrinini. Ingasi ngokukhangisa, ukulinganisa isikwelede, iinqunto zokuboleka nanyana ukuthengisela nanyana ngubani. Ukunikela ilwazi kungokuzithandela; ngaphandle kwalo asikho isibikezelo.

where.title: Lapho kusetjenzwa khona
where.body:
Njengesivakatjhi, koke kuhlala ebhrawuzarini le esisetjenzisweni lesi begodu isibikezelo sibalwa esisetjenzisweni. Akukho okuthunyelwa ku-Tengo.
Nangabe ukhetha ukubulunga i-akhawunti, ilwazi lakho libulungwa mhlinzeki wesizindalwazi obalwe ekulungiseleleni (Supabase), esifundeni esikhethwe msebenzisi, begodu lithunyelwa ngokuthintana okuvikelekileko. Isibikezelo sisabalwa esisetjenzisweni sakho. Nanyana ngikuphi ukubulunga ngaphandle kweSewula Afrika kutlhoga ukuvikelwa okwaneleko ngaphasi kwesigaba 72 se-POPIA begodu kuzokubalwa lapha ngaphambi kokuthonywa.

who.title: Ngubani ongakubona
who.body: Njengesivakatjhi: nanyana ngubani osebenzisa ibhrawuza le esisetjenzisweni lesi. Sebenzisa ukukhiya nge-PIN efowunini eyabelanwako. Nge-akhawunti: wena, ngemva kokungena. Imigqa yomuntu ngamunye ikhiyelwe kuye esizindalwazini. Akukho ukufikelela kwabasebenzi emigqeni yakho okulungiselelweko. Nangabe isizo sakhe sikutlhoga, isaziso lesi sizokuthoma sitjho bona kukhawulelwa begodu kurekhodwa njani.

keep.title: Kubulungwa isikhathi esingangani
keep.body: Amathengiselwano angaphezu kweenyanga ezili-12 ayasuswa esisetjenzisweni lesi nangabe i-Tengo ivuleka. Ku-akhawunti, umsebenzi weseva wokuwasusa utloliwe kodwana awukavulwa. Ungasula koke nanyana kunini; ku-akhawunti, ukusula kususa imigqa yakho nokungena kwakho, begodu ufumana irasidi elingenalo ilwazi lomuntu. Iinkopi zokubulunga ezibulungwa mhlinzeki wokusingatha zisulwa ngokwehlelo lakhe, elizokubalwa lapha ngaphambi kokuthonywa.

rights.title: Amalungelo wakho
rights.body: Ungabona ilwazi lakho begodu ulikhuphe njenge-JSON nanyana i-CSV, ulungise nanyana ngikuphi okufakiweko, ubawe umuntu bona ahlole umphumela, ukhuphe nanyana ngikuphi ukukhetha, begodu usule koke. Ungakhalaza ehlanganweni ephetheko engehla, nakuMlawuli weLwazi weSewula Afrika.

not.title: Lokho i-Tengo engasikho
not.body: I-Tengo kulinga. Akusi libhanga, akusi mhlinzeki wesikwelede begodu akusi meluleki weemali. Iinomboro zayo ziinlinganiso ezivela emlandweni wakho, begodu ayenzi iinqunto ngawe.

changes.title: Iintjhugululo
changes.body: Nangabe isaziso lesi siyatjhugululeka, ihlelo elingehla liyatjhugululeka begodu i-Tengo ikubawa bona usiqale godu ngaphambi kobana uragele phambili.

use.title: Ukusebenzisa i-Tengo
use.body: I-Tengo imahala ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi sokulinga. Ngeyabantu abadala, abaneminyaka eli-18 nanyana ngaphezulu. Yisebenzise kwaphela ngemali yakho nanyana ngeenomboro zokuzenzisa.

estimate.title: Iinlinganiso, ingasi iinthembiso
estimate.body: Woke ilanga, isabelomali nesiphakamiso sisilinganiso esivela emaphethinini wangaphambili. Imali ingangena kade nanyana ingangeni nokungena, begodu amabhadelo angatjhugululeka. Hlola ngaphambi kokwenza isiqunto esiqakathekileko.

liability.title: Iinqunto zakho
liability.body: I-Tengo ayinikeli iinyeluleko zeemali begodu ayinasibopho ngeenqunto ozenzako uyisebenzisa. Akukho lapha okukhawulela amalungelo onawo ngaphasi komthetho weSewula Afrika.

accounts.title: Ii-akhawunti
accounts.body: Ii-akhawunti ngezokuzikhethela. Gcina ukufikelela ekhelini lakho le-imeyili, ngombana ukungena kwenziwa ngekhowudi yesikhathi sinye. Ungaphuma yoke indawo begodu usule i-akhawunti yakho nanyana kunini.

ending.title: Ukuphela kokulinga
ending.body: Nangabe ukulinga kuyaphela, uzokutjelwa ku-app begodu unikelwe isikhathi sokukhupha ilwazi lakho ngaphambi kobana lisulwe.

complaints.title: Iinkhalazo
complaints.body: Thintana nehlangano ephetheko engehla. Ngeenkhalazo zefihlo ungaya godu kuMlawuli weLwazi weSewula Afrika.

account.title: I-akhawunti
account.unavailable: Ii-akhawunti azikalungiselelwa ekopini le ye-Tengo. Iphrofayili yakho ihlala esisetjenzisweni lesi.
account.lead: Bulunga ku-akhawunti bona ukubulunge nanyana ngesiphi isisetjenziswa. Kungokuzikhethela: i-Tengo isebenza ngokupheleleko ngaphandle kwayo.
account.leadSaved: Iphrofayili yakho ibulungwe ku-akhawunti yakho. Isibikezelo sakho sisabalwa esisetjenzisweni lesi.

facts.passwordless: Alikho ibizo elifihlakeleko: ungena ngekhowudi yesikhathi sinye ethunyelwa ku-imeyili yakho.
facts.device: Isibikezelo sakho sisabalwa esisetjenzisweni sakho. I-akhawunti ibulunga ilwazi lakho kwaphela.
facts.where: Kubulungwe mhlinzeki wesizindalwazi obalwe esazisweni sefihlo. Nguwe kwaphela ongafunda imigqa yakho.
facts.leave: Phuma yoke indawo, khupha nanyana usule koke nanyana kunini.

account.resendIn_other: Thumela ikhowudi etjha ngemva kwamasekhondi ali-{{count}}
account.uploadLead: I-akhawunti yakho ayinalitho. Bulunga iphrofayili yakho ukusuka esisetjenzisweni lesi kiyo. Ngemva kwalokho isuswa esisetjenzisweni lesi begodu ibulungwe ku-akhawunti yakho.
account.emptyLead: I-akhawunti yakho itjha begodu ayinalitho. Faka imali yakho bona ufumane isibikezelo sakho sokuthoma.
account.conflictLead: Isisetjenziswa lesi naso sineprofayili. Ngokujayelekileko ubulunga ilwazi le-akhawunti. Ungalithathela indawo ngelwazi lesisetjenziswa lesi esikhundleni salokho.
account.useLead: Ilwazi le-akhawunti yakho lizokusetjenziswa esisetjenzisweni lesi.
account.replaceWarn: Ukuthathela indawo kususa lokho i-akhawunti enakho nje begodu angekhe kubuyiselwe emuva.
account.savedFacts: Khupha koke iseva ekubulungako nanyana kunini, njenge-JSON nanyana i-CSV.
account.deleteBody: Kususa yoke imigqa iseva enayo ngawe nokungena kwakho, begodu ikunikele irasidi elingenalo ilwazi lomuntu. Iinkopi zokubulunga ezibulungwa mhlinzeki wokusingatha ziphelelwa sikhathi ngokwehlelo lakhe, elibalwe esazisweni sefihlo.
account.deleteWarn: Lokhu angekhe kubuyiselwe emuva. Khupha kokuthoma nangabe ufuna ikopi.

errors.invalid_code: Ikhowudi leyo ayikasebenzi. Yihlole, nanyana uthumele etjha.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungakahambi kuhle. Hlola ukuthintana kwakho bese ulinga godu.
